epg.title: Sumangali
epg.description: Marries Santhosh, a rich, arrogant man who initially dislikes her. Their lives change as they become husband and wife. The story explores their journey of living together after marriage.

epg.title: Chi Sou Mahalakshmi
epg.description: Kanaka's dreams shatter after betrayal pulls her into conspiracies, while Vishal faces his own turmoil. Fate unites them in an unexpected marriage, leading to a journey of conflict and secrets.

epg.title: Raktha Sambandha
epg.description: Priya secretly swaps her son with Kanaka Durga's daughter to fulfill her wish for a boy. Years later, the truth and property clash rip the once-close family apart.

epg.title: Mane Aliya
epg.description: A powerful retelling of ancient legends and moral questions, blending heroism, inner turmoil, and epic confrontations that echo through personal and spiritual challenges.

epg.title: Meghasandesha
epg.description: Gagan and Bhoomi are separated from their fathers by a tragedy. Bhoomi seeks her roots, while Gagan hates his father. Fate brings them together on an unknown journey. Will they find peace?

epg.title: Shravani Subramanya
epg.description: Shravani must marry to please her father. Discovering the groom's evil plan, she pretends to marry Subramanya instead. Can she keep up the act forever?

epg.title: Krishna Rukku
epg.description: Playful arguments between Krishna and Rukmini slowly transform into deep affection as love blossoms through humour and emotional moments.

epg.title: Amruthadhaare
epg.description: Gautam, a businessman, marries Bhumika, a middle-class woman, for convenience. Can their marriage blossom into true love? Will their different worlds find common ground?

epg.title: Annayya
epg.description: Shivanna wants his four sisters married. But learning of their dreams, he changes his mind. He dedicates himself to helping them achieve their life goals instead.

epg.title: Karna

epg.title: Adilakashmi Purana

epg.title: Naa Ninna Bidalarre
epg.description: Desperate spirit Ambika seeks her sister, Durga, who can see her. Ambika needs Durga's help to save her daughter. Together, they face a powerful, unseen threat.

epg.title: Brahmagantu

epg.description: Mike gets assigned in the same group with Lucy for history class and enjoys the time studying and eating Hamburger with Lucy, who he has a crush on.

epg.title: Top of Coit Tower
epg.description: One day, X shows up at Mike's house. X attacks Mike with Crying Man and tries to take all the Hero Books, while Mike uses Sylph to bring back Crying Man's Hero Book.

epg.title: Revolution
epg.description: Lucy explains to Mike that Scott who created the Hero Books is her uncle and that she's collecting the Hero Books to find clues to her missing uncle.

epg.title: Villains vs Heroes
epg.description: The battle between Dirk O's gang versus Mike and X breaks out, and with Diro O's overwhelming power, the entire city is in danger.

epg.title: Strawberry On The Air
epg.description: Mike and Lucy become a team through Season 1. They rescue a plane crashing into the sea in front of the city and show the abilities as a new team as heroes.

epg.title: Criminals and Chameleon
epg.description: Mike and Lucy defeat the villains who use Chameli with the ability of a chameleon to commit crimes. However, the police and citizens treat all Hero Book Readers as criminals.

epg.title: Hard-Hitting Interview
epg.description: Tara interviews Super Awesome Man and X through Nick. Mike tries his best not to get caught by Tara. Meanwhile, Mike's group chasing Chameli runs into Christa and Timo.

epg.description: Mike's group engages in their first battle with Christa, and they are overwhelmed by her power, even losing the Hero Book. In a moment of crisis, Mike reveals a new power, 'Comical Create'.

epg.description: The Council of Comics, stealing the 25 Cent's Hero Book from bank robbers, gather to create Nerd-utopia at their hideout, Papa Princess's house.

epg.description: Mike and his friends receive information from the Justice Boosters and visit Mrs. Cubbenson. There, they encounter Papa Princess, a member of the Council of Comics, and engage in a battle.

epg.title: Special Delivery
epg.description: Cynthia's condition gets worse, and Super Scott feels being in danger. Christa's group continues to battle in search of the Dizzy 7 Hero Books and engages in a battle with the Council of Comics.

epg.title: Get The Book
epg.description: The Council of Comics, chasing Christa to the milk tea shop, witnesses Super Scott's abilities and engages in a battle to seize his comic book.

epg.description: Chasing after Super Scott's Hero Book through the city, the main characters finally encounter Super Scott on a giant suspension bridge.

epg.title: Cry for Justice
epg.description: Mike comes across a Hero Book, a comic book that summons a hero when the hero's name is called, and saves his friend Nick from danger using Crying Man from a comic book.

epg.title: The Darkest Night
epg.description: With Dirk O's order to steal a Hero Book, Black Knight accidentally sets a house on fire, and Mike uses Crying Man to put out the fire and saves people.
